request.style: English, female soulful jazz vocal, solo with subtle choir harmonies, upright bass, brushed drums, piano, double bass, warm and reflective mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They asked me to give glory to God
Saying the healer was a sinner
I stood before them with no fear
Answering with steady and quiet spirit

[Chorus]
One thing I do know
I was blind and now I see
One thing I do know
The light has broken through

[Verse]
They asked what he did to my eyes
How he opened them to the day
I said I told you before
Why do you ask me to speak again

[Chorus]
One thing I do know
I was blind and now I see
One thing I do know
The light has broken through

[Bridge]
Do you want to become his disciples too
Or stay where the darkness keeps its hold
I will not hide the truth of this life
The vision that was given to me

[Chorus]
One thing I do know
I was blind and now I see
One thing I do know
The light has broken through

[Outro]
I was blind and now I see
